overall: The AG found no violation: the March 6 minutes were approved on April 3, within the timeline, and the other meetings were not yet overdue when the complaint was filed. The AG cautioned that workshop meetings count toward timely minutes approval.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve minutes for several early-2024 meetings, having approved only the January and February minutes as of April 8.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board timely approved minutes of its March 6 meeting when it approved the minutes on April 3.
